name: by_symbol
shape: DataCube level 1: trades grouped by Sym, Qty pivoted on Side, sorted by Notional, limited to maxRows + 1
pure: #>{md::MarketData.trades}#->extend(~Notional: x | $x.Qty * $x.Price)->select(~[Sym, Side, Qty, Price, Notional, Timestamp])->groupBy(~[Sym], ~['BUY__|__Qty': x | if($x.Side == 'BUY', | $x.Qty, | []) : y | $y->sum(), 'SELL__|__Qty': x | if($x.Side == 'SELL', | $x.Qty, | []) : y | $y->sum(), Qty: x | $x.Qty : y | $y->sum(), Notional: x | $x.Notional : y | $y->sum(), Trades: x | 1 : y | $y->count(), VWAP: x | wavgRowMapper($x.Price, $x.Qty) : y | $y->wavg(), Last: x | $x.Price : y | $y->last(), LastTs: x | $x.Timestamp : y | $y->max()])->sort(~Notional->descending())->limit(1001)
